♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: Today’s Taurus Moon moves through your 2nd house in Rohini, turning your fire toward tangible comfort, food, and security. The Sun, Venus and Ketu cluster in Virgo in your 6th house, sharpening your focus on work quality, body rhythms and how you handle obligations. Saturn in Pisces in your 12th presses you to be honest about what drains you behind the scenes, while Rahu in Pisces keeps your subconscious busy with half-formed ideas and worries.

💼 Career: This is a strong day for steady, hands-on work and refining a specific skill. The Virgo 6th-house focus favors organizing files, tightening workflows, or improving the way you deliver a service. You may notice where perfectionism slows you down; aim for “reliable” instead of “flawless.” Quiet political currents at work could be moving—observe more than you react. If someone hints at extra duties, negotiate boundaries clearly rather than agreeing on impulse.

❤️ Love: The Taurus Moon wants warmth expressed through simple, consistent gestures—good food, a comfortable space, physical affection. With Venus in your 6th, love may feel practical: doing a favor, helping with a task, or showing up when promised. If partnered, shared routines (sleep, meals, chores) are where harmony or friction shows. If single, attraction can spark with someone you see regularly in everyday settings—gym, commute, café, or workplace—who feels calm and grounded rather than dramatic.

💰 Money: Lunar emphasis on your 2nd house invites you to stabilize rather than stretch. Think about what truly nourishes you versus what just looks impressive. This is a favorable day to price your work more realistically, review subscriptions, or redirect a small expense toward savings. Avoid comparing your pace of progress with others; your money story is currently built one consistent habit at a time, not by a single big move.

🧘 Advice: Let slow, deliberate choices set the tone. You don’t need a huge breakthrough today—just one or two concrete decisions that honor your energy and your worth.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When your actions match what you say you value, confidence stops being a performance and starts feeling like home.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon is in your own sign and in its favorite nakshatra, Rohini, lighting up your 1st house. Your body, senses and preferences are louder than usual—notice what feels delicious and what feels heavy. The Virgo Sun with Venus and Ketu in your 5th house energizes creativity, romance and personal expression, while Saturn in your 11th asks you to be realistic about which friendships and long-term plans still fit.

💼 Career: You come across as composed and capable, even if you feel a bit tender inside. This is a good day for work that requires aesthetic sense, patience, or careful craftsmanship. You might revisit an older idea—a design, proposal or side project—and realize it can be reshaped into something viable. Be selective about new commitments: it’s better to pour consistent effort into fewer goals than scatter yourself across every opportunity that appears.

❤️ Love: With the Moon in your sign and Venus activating your 5th, there’s a soft glow around your relationships. If partnered, the focus leans toward shared pleasure—art, music, food, intimacy—rather than heavy discussions. Let your partner see your affectionate, playful side. If single, your natural magnetism is strong; people notice your eyes, your voice, or your calm presence. Don’t downplay your needs to stay “easygoing”—someone who is right for you will appreciate your clear preferences.

💰 Money: Taurus and Rohini together emphasize comfort spending, so be mindful: are you nurturing yourself or numbing yourself? This is a favorable day for solid money moves—setting a savings target, consolidating small debts, or investing in something that genuinely enhances your skills or wellbeing. Avoid lending or borrowing out of guilt; let financial generosity be a choice, not an obligation.

🧘 Advice: Let your senses guide you. Your body is giving you accurate feedback today about what and who is good for you—listen to it before you override it with logic.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop apologizing for your desires, life finally has room to meet them.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: The Taurus Moon moves through your 12th house, slowing your usually quick mind and drawing you into the inner rooms of your psyche. Rohini’s influence makes this introspection sensual and emotional rather than purely mental—dreams, music, and memories feel vivid. The Virgo Sun with Venus and Ketu in your 4th house stirs old family stories and questions about what “home” really means for you now. Saturn and Rahu in Pisces at the top of your chart press quietly on career direction without giving full clarity yet.

💼 Career: This is more of a background-processing day than a loud achievement one. You may function better working alone or on tasks that allow you to drift slightly while your subconscious sorts things out. If your professional path feels foggy, don’t force an instant answer; take notes on what feels energetically heavy versus alive. Someone from your past—an old colleague, teacher, or family contact—may cross your mind or appear, bringing context about your current choices.

❤️ Love: The 12th-house Moon can stir nostalgia, longing, or a desire for connection that feels safe enough to fully relax in. In existing relationships, you may crave quiet time away from noise: talking in low light, sharing a secret fear, or simply resting together. If single, you might feel drawn toward a private, almost fated-feeling connection, or find yourself thinking about a past love. Let feelings rise and fall without instantly acting on every impulse.

💰 Money: Today favors subtle adjustments rather than big financial moves. The Virgo 4th-house cluster points to expenses or plans around home, repairs, or relocations. Before you commit, look at the emotional motivation: are you trying to “fix” a feeling with a purchase? Small, practical steps—organizing documents, checking due dates, clarifying shared bills—will have more impact than chasing a new scheme.

🧘 Advice: Treat quiet as medicine. Give your mind just enough structure—journaling, a slow walk, gentle music—to let deeper insights bubble up without pressure.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop running from silence, it stops chasing you and starts answering you.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: With the Moon—your ruler—in Taurus and Rohini, your 11th house of networks, groups and future visions is illuminated. There’s a strong pull toward trusted friends and communities that feel nourishing rather than draining. The Virgo Sun with Venus and Ketu in your 3rd house energizes communication, writing, and short journeys. Saturn and Rahu in Pisces in your 9th push you to mature your beliefs and long-term plans.

💼 Career: Today supports teamwork grounded in shared values. You may find it easier to identify who in your professional circle genuinely supports your growth and who simply occupies space. Conversations about big-picture goals—projects, collaborations, courses or relocations—are favored, especially if they’re rooted in realistic timelines. You don’t have to decide everything today; sketching the contours of your next chapter is enough.

❤️ Love: Social spaces may influence your love life now. If partnered, spending time with friends or participating in a group activity can show you how your relationship functions in a wider context—do you feel like a genuine team, or do you shrink to keep the peace? If single, introductions through friends, online communities, or shared interests can be meaningful. You may be drawn to someone whose worldview or background widens your own.

💰 Money: The 11th house is tied to long-range earnings and wishes; today is ideal for revisiting savings goals, planning for a future purchase, or considering how your skills could generate more stable income over time. Virgo’s 3rd-house influence favors learning something practical about money—budgeting tools, taxes, or contracts—through a course, article, or conversation. Choose steady strategies over flashy promises.

🧘 Advice: Let yourself lean on your people, but also be precise about what you’re asking for. Mutual clarity makes support more satisfying for everyone involved.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your circle shapes your horizon—choose people who remind you of how much is possible, not how little you deserve.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Taurus Moon climbs to the top of your chart into your 10th house, putting your public role and responsibilities in the spotlight. Rohini’s influence makes you especially concerned with quality and beauty in what you present. The Virgo Sun, Venus and Ketu in your 2nd house underline questions of income, self-worth and material stability, while Saturn and Rahu in Pisces in your 8th house add quiet pressure around shared resources, debts or emotional entanglements.

💼 Career: Visibility is heightened. You may be recognized today for something you’ve done consistently rather than dramatically. The energy favors refining your professional image—updating a profile, portfolio, or proposal—so it better reflects who you are now. Discussions concerning pay, title, or responsibilities can arise; bring facts, not just pride, to the table. If there’s a power dynamic that’s been bothering you, observe how it plays out today before deciding on your next move.

❤️ Love: With your mind on status and security, you could seem preoccupied to loved ones unless you slow down and share what’s on your heart. In partnerships, honest conversations about money, lifestyle expectations, and future goals may surface. Try to listen without defensiveness when your partner shares their worries. Single Leos might feel pulled toward people who are accomplished or influential—notice whether you’re attracted to their essence or their image.

💰 Money: This is a grounded day for financial evaluation. The 2nd- and 8th-house emphasis brings attention to salaries, shared bills, and longer-term commitments like loans or investments. Rather than fearing what you’ll find, treat your finances like a project you can gently improve. A small, responsible choice today—adjusting a recurring expense, starting an automatic transfer, or clarifying who pays what—can reduce background stress significantly.

🧘 Advice: Let your dignity come from how you handle realities, not from pretending to be above them. Owning the numbers is an act of leadership, too.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: True authority starts the moment you stop outsourcing your value to other people’s approval.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Taurus activates your 9th house, turning your attention to learning, travel, spiritual practice and the bigger story of your life. Rohini adds a fertile, hopeful tone—you may feel an urge to grow beyond your current containers. The Sun, Venus and Ketu in Virgo in your 1st house put your identity and choices under a bright, honest light. Saturn and Rahu in Pisces in your 7th house continue to reshape your approach to partnership and agreements.

💼 Career: This is an excellent day to step back and look at where your work is taking you over the next few years. Consider which skills you want to deepen, which roles feel outdated, and what kind of impact matters to you. Training, certification, or mentorship can be especially fruitful topics to explore. Be mindful of over-correcting yourself; growth doesn’t require declaring that all your past choices were wrong—it asks you to update them with what you know now.

❤️ Love: Relationship themes today revolve around compatibility of beliefs and directions. In existing partnerships, conversations about future plans—countries you’d like to live in, values you want to build your life around, or how you each define commitment—are supported. If single, you may feel drawn to people from different cultures, backgrounds or philosophies, or to someone you meet through study, travel or spiritual spaces.

💰 Money: The 9th-house Moon is more about perspective than immediate gain. You might explore financial education—books, podcasts, courses—that helps you see money as a tool aligned with your values rather than just a source of anxiety. Investment or legal decisions connected to partners or contracts require careful reading; don’t rush into any commitment you don’t fully understand.

🧘 Advice: Give yourself permission to be a work in progress in full view of others. You’re allowed to adjust your path without having every detail planned.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Clarity about where you’re heading often appears only after you start walking in the direction that feels honest, not perfect.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Taurus Moon in your 8th house steers you toward deeper layers—shared resources, emotional knots, and subjects you usually keep tucked away. Rohini adds a desire for tenderness and loyalty amid all that intensity. The Virgo Sun with Venus and Ketu in your 12th house highlights endings, healing, and hidden patterns seeking closure. Saturn and Rahu in Pisces in your 6th house nudge you to take responsibility for your habits and health without harshness.

💼 Career: Work may feel slightly opaque today—there can be behind-the-scenes conversations, budget issues, or shifts in roles that you sense before you see. Rather than trying to control everything, focus on what is truly yours to manage: your diligence, your boundaries, and your ethics. This is a good day to quietly review contracts, confidential arrangements, or obligations you’ve taken on for others. Ask yourself: what am I still doing out of old guilt or fear that no longer makes sense?

❤️ Love: The 8th- and 12th-house emphasis makes this a day of emotional honesty. In partnerships, topics like trust, intimacy, and how you each cope with stress may arise. Instead of skating over discomfort to stay “harmonious,” lean into gentle, truthful dialogue. If single, you might feel drawn to complex, private connections; check whether the attraction feels healing or just dramatic. Your heart is seeking depth, but it also deserves safety.

💰 Money: Shared finances, debts, inheritances, and long-term financial entanglements are highlighted. It’s a useful day for gathering information: listing balances, understanding interest rates, or clarifying who is responsible for what. Avoid making major financial moves purely from emotion—fear, rescue impulses, or fantasies. Ground every decision in actual numbers and realistic timelines.

🧘 Advice: Give yourself time alone to feel what you feel without editing it to seem reasonable. Once you’ve acknowledged the truth inwardly, the right outer step becomes clearer.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Peace that requires you to ignore your deeper needs isn’t peace—it’s a performance that quietly exhausts you.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Taurus Moon travels through your 7th house, throwing the spotlight on one-to-one relationships—partners, close friends, clients, even opponents. Rohini’s energy seeks stability and sensual connection, not quick fixes. The Virgo Sun with Venus and Ketu in your 11th house stirs your social world, group roles and long-term aspirations. Saturn and Rahu in Pisces in your 5th house highlight matters of the heart, children, creativity and the risks you’re willing to take.

💼 Career: Collaborations and key alliances are central today. You may receive feedback—spoken or unspoken—about how you operate as a partner or team player. Take note without rushing to defend yourself. It’s a good moment to clarify expectations in joint projects: who owns what, which deadlines are realistic, how credit will be shared. An opportunity connected to a community, organization, or online audience may appear; balance your desire for influence with the need to protect your creative integrity.

❤️ Love: The 7th-house Moon makes relational dynamics vivid. If you’re partnered, your attention may go to how dependable and present you both feel for each other in daily life, not just in dramatic moments. Conversations about what each of you needs to feel cherished are well-timed. If single, you might notice someone whose presence feels calming and grounded amidst a lively group setting—or a friend may suddenly seem like more than a friend.

💰 Money: Agreements are the keyword. Shared expenses, joint purchases, or financial commitments related to group ventures can come up. Make sure there’s clarity on contributions and exit plans before you say yes. This is also a favorable day to review how your social life influences your spending—events, memberships, or habits you maintain mainly to keep up appearances.

🧘 Advice: Let others mirror you, but don’t hand them the final verdict on who you are. Their reflections are data points, not destiny.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The right partnerships don’t dilute your power; they give it a direction you couldn’t reach alone.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Taurus Moon in your 6th house draws attention to work routines, bodily rhythms, and how you manage time and energy. Rohini likes slow, sustainable pleasure, suggesting small upgrades to everyday life rather than grand gestures. The Virgo Sun with Venus and Ketu in your 10th house spotlights career, reputation and the shape of your ambitions. Saturn and Rahu in Pisces in your 4th house keep asking you to build a more solid inner and domestic foundation.

💼 Career: This is a day when practical effort counts more than big visions. You may receive recognition for reliability, detailed follow-through, or a process improvement you propose. Take stock of your current responsibilities: which tasks truly move you toward your long-term goals and which are legacy obligations you could delegate or phase out? A conversation with a supervisor, mentor, or client may help you refine your direction—be honest about what workload is actually sustainable.

❤️ Love: Because work and duty are loud, romance thrives through small acts of care—remembering a preference, handling an errand, or simply being fully present for a conversation. If partnered, discussions about how you divide chores, caregiving and emotional labor can lead to more balance if approached kindly. If single, you may feel drawn to someone whose steadiness and competence impress you in practical settings—office, clinic, classroom, or volunteer work.

💰 Money: The 6th-house Moon favors incremental financial improvements: negotiating a small raise, trimming recurring expenses, or creating a realistic budget that reflects your actual daily life, not an idealized version. The 10th-house emphasis might bring expenses related to career—courses, tools, professional clothing. Invest where it genuinely expands your options rather than just upgrading your image.

🧘 Advice: Treat your schedule as a living ecosystem. When you adjust one habit with care, the whole system slowly starts to support you back.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Freedom doesn’t vanish when you commit; it changes shape into trust that tomorrow won’t depend on today’s last-minute scramble.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Taurus Moon in your 5th house adds a gentle, creative, and even romantic glow to your usually disciplined approach. Rohini’s influence encourages you to savor enjoyment without guilt. The Virgo Sun with Venus and Ketu in your 9th house opens doors toward learning, travel, and rethinking your beliefs. Saturn and Rahu in Pisces in your 3rd house keep your mind working steadily on communication, skills and daily decisions.

💼 Career: Today favors work that allows some creativity or mentoring. You may find fresh approaches to projects that had felt dry, or see a way to turn a talent or hobby into a more serious avenue over time. Conversations related to education, publishing, international connections or legal matters could progress; your pragmatic eye is valuable in turning big ideas into structured plans. Teach, present, or share your knowledge where appropriate—people are more receptive to your perspective than you might think.

❤️ Love: The 5th-house Moon wants you to remember that you’re not just a provider or problem-solver—you’re also someone capable of joy and warmth. In partnerships, plan something you can actually look forward to, even if simple: a favorite meal, a walk, a shared film or class. If single, you may feel drawn to someone who blends earthiness with curiosity—perhaps met through a course, trip, or shared intellectual interest.

💰 Money: Financially, it’s a good day to consider investments—of money, time, or effort—in things that broaden your horizons: courses, certifications, equipment that supports a creative or teaching path. The key is discernment: avoid signing anything you haven’t fully read, and be wary of “once in a lifetime” pitches. Solid, patient growth is your ally now.

🧘 Advice: Let yourself enjoy being inspired without immediately turning every spark into a heavy responsibility. Some ideas just need space to breathe first.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you allow pleasure to coexist with duty, your discipline stops feeling like a cage and starts feeling like a path.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Taurus Moon falls in your 4th house, bringing your attention to home, family, and your inner emotional weather. Rohini’s touch makes you crave softness, stability and beauty in your private space. The Virgo Sun with Venus and Ketu in your 8th house highlights shared resources, intimacy, and psychological excavation. Saturn and Rahu in Pisces in your 2nd house continue their slow restructuring of your finances and self-worth.

💼 Career: Even if work is busy, your real work today may be internal. Questions around how secure you feel—with money, with colleagues, with your own capabilities—may surface. Rather than pushing them aside, take note. Background tasks related to budgets, investments, insurance, or long-term agreements are supported; you may catch details you previously glossed over. If the option exists, working from home or making your workspace more comfortable can boost focus.

❤️ Love: Emotional safety is front and center. In existing relationships, you may feel called to talk about how you handle vulnerability, secrets, or shared responsibilities. This can deepen trust if approached with patience and no blame. If single, you might be less interested in casual connections and more drawn to someone who feels emotionally reliable and grounded. Notice who makes your nervous system relax rather than spike.

💰 Money: The 2nd–8th house axis is active, making this a meaningful day for financial clarity. Review joint accounts, loans, subscriptions, or agreements; ensure they match your current reality and not an older version of your life. You don’t have to fix everything at once—prioritize one step that reduces uncertainty, like organizing statements or setting a reminder to renegotiate a term.

🧘 Advice: Treat your home and inner world as the soil from which all else grows. A small act of care there can ripple out into surprising areas of life.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The security you keep searching for out there starts with how gently and consistently you choose yourself in here.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The Taurus Moon in your 3rd house steadies your mind and encourages practical communication. Rohini brings a warm, affectionate quality to your words and gestures. The Virgo Sun with Venus and Ketu in your 7th house throws a bright, sometimes unforgiving light on partnership dynamics and important agreements. Saturn and Rahu in Pisces in your 1st house continue to reshape your identity, asking you to grow up where you’ve been drifting, without losing your softness.

💼 Career: Today is excellent for conversations, planning and follow-ups. Client meetings, contract discussions, and cooperative projects can move forward if you stay grounded and specific. Be willing to name what you can realistically deliver and what you cannot. Feedback from a collaborator or partner may sting at first but can be genuinely useful if you listen for the kernel of truth rather than the tone.

❤️ Love: Relationships sit in the foreground. In ongoing partnerships, patterns of giving and receiving may show up clearly: who initiates, who organizes, who accommodates. Use this visibility as a chance to adjust, not to keep score. If single, you might encounter someone in everyday settings—neighborhood, commute, online chats—who feels surprisingly aligned. Let the connection develop slowly through real conversations instead of rushing to define it.

💰 Money: Practical conversations about money with partners, housemates, or collaborators are supported. The 3rd-house Moon helps you break down numbers into manageable pieces instead of feeling overwhelmed. Agreements about shared expenses, timelines, or boundaries can be clarified now. Avoid making new financial promises just to keep the peace; long-term harmony needs honesty more than instant comfort.

🧘 Advice: Anchor your sensitivity in clear language. Saying what you mean kindly—but firmly—protects both your heart and your time.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your intuition is powerful, but when you pair it with straightforward words, it becomes life-changing—for you and for others.
